scope: Live authenticated Batch 2 builds fail at the semantic planner with PLANNER_SCHEMA_INVALID or PLANNER_INVALID_OUTPUT, and the validation detail is discarded. Log reason, repair count and a 300-character validation detail (never the prompt or raw reply) so the cause is visible.

keep: Planner contract and failure codes are unchanged
extend: Planner failure now emits one bounded diagnostic log line

schemaImpact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy the previous image.

egress.description: No egress change; the line goes to the existing process log only.

tests.scope: Log line carries reason, repairs and bounded detail and excludes the prompt and raw reply. 2 PASS.

architecture.reason: Adds one log line inside the existing planner. No new orchestrator or control plane.

rollout: Merge after required checks, build the release image, create a 0% revision, then repeat the authenticated build to read the log line.
rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy; restore the previous service revision and Job image and label.
knownGaps: Does not fix the planner failure; it only makes the cause visible
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Batch 2 building is not accepted until a live authenticated build saves a revision
